clause.text: No person shall be subject to any disability or restriction regarding access to public places on the grounds of race, religion, language, caste or sex.

case_context.legal_issue: Whether the petitioner was subjected to any disability or restriction regarding access to public places on prohibited grounds during his arrest and detention.

link_explanation.why_this_clause_matters: Article 12(3) was not materially engaged or discussed in the court’s reasoning or decision.
